intent: Teach grammar as help rather than a guarantee; possible vocabulary growth; language/window metaphor; an explicitly new bridge picture illustrating word meaning; translation as a noun and comparison to source; translate as an attempted action in own words; the personal better-than direction; memorising plus application without banning memory. Preserve both memorise and memorize.
picturePurpose: Five original coded tasks and one original bridge/river picture support actual comparison, grammatical application and word-meaning interaction; two evidence selections test source constraints. New examples are explicitly marked.

三条新信息
把你的译文与原通知比较。试着用自己的话解释这张图表。比起文字指示，我更容易看懂地图。
词语提示：notice 通知；chart 图表；instructions 指示。
